O nível vale para a primeira assinatura: The level applies to the first signature on the PDF (certification signature, DocMDP) and doesn’t change afterwards. When signing, you can change the level for that PDF. A PDF with more than one signature field uses level 2 automatically, and Prumo confirms with you before signing. No level stops another program from saving a change to the file: what changes is that the signature stops being valid (or is marked as changed), and readers such as Adobe Acrobat warn about it. That’s why Prumo signs a copy (“Name - signed”), keeps the original editable and turns off the editing tools on the copy.
